meta.title: Ouefvoke
meta.author: Teo (Rebels)
meta.description: The soundtrack of Ouefvoke by Rebels (2023-07-29). A 64K intro that shared 1st place in the PC 64K intro competition at Evoke 2023. Music credited to Teo on Demozoo. 110 BPM, 2:02, 18 tracks, 2109 notes. Instruments: 2 Falcon (FM synth), 2 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 8 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 1 Scissor, 2 Leveller, 2 Echo, 5 Smasher, 1 Chamber. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by -0.47 dB loudness and at most 0.68 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
